s1.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness in an infant with fever and rhinorrhea
salient_findings: Mild enlargement of the mediastinum shadow on chest X-ray
key_facts: Close contact with grandmother who had rhinorrhea and throat irritation
White blood cell count: 10.23 × 10⁹ cells per L
RT-PCR tests from nasopharyngeal swabs: positive (Feb 8)

raw.syndrome_frame: Acute respiratory illness in an infant with fever and rhinorrhea
salient_findings: Mild enlargement of the mediastinum shadow on chest X-ray
key_facts: Close contact with grandmother who had rhinorrhea and throat irritation
White blood cell count: 10.23 × 10⁹ cells per L
RT-PCR tests from nasopharyngeal swabs: positive (Feb 8)

shortlist.label: Respiratory Syncytial Virus infection
shortlist.why_kept: Positive RT-PCR from nasopharyngeal swab and symptoms consistent with viral respiratory infection

shortlist.label: Rhinovirus infection
shortlist.why_kept: Symptoms of rhinorrhea and nasal congestion, common in rhinovirus infections

shortlist.label: Adenovirus infection
shortlist.why_kept: Fever and respiratory symptoms consistent with adenovirus infection

shortlist.label: Coronavirus infection
shortlist.why_kept: Respiratory symptoms and close contact with grandmother who had similar symptoms

shortlist.label: Human Metapneumovirus infection
shortlist.why_kept: Respiratory symptoms and age of patient, consistent with human metapneumovirus infection

raw.rationale: The patient's symptoms of rhinorrhea and nasal congestion without cough, vomiting, diarrhea, wheezing, or dyspnea, along with a history of close contact with a grandmother who had similar symptoms, are consistent with a rhinovirus infection. The lack of severe respiratory symptoms and the normal chest radiograph also support this diagnosis.

rejected.label: Respiratory Syncytial Virus infection
rejected.why: Typically causes more severe respiratory symptoms, especially in young infants

rejected.label: Adenovirus infection
rejected.why: Often presents with additional symptoms such as conjunctivitis or gastroenteritis, which are not mentioned in the case

rejected.label: Coronavirus infection
rejected.why: The clinical presentation and laboratory results do not specifically suggest a coronavirus infection, and the patient's age and lack of severe symptoms make this less likely

rejected.label: Human Metapneumovirus infection
rejected.why: Usually causes more severe lower respiratory tract symptoms, which are not present in this case
